While the main body resembles an iron (soleplate, handle), the failure of the classifier and the nonsensical cord structure severely degrade class conformance. Only 7/10 checkpoints were passed, with critical functional components (cord, controls, steam holes) missing or malformed. The score is penalized heavily for the classifier mismatch and the non-functional cord.

This is a high-severity (4.5/5) semantic and structural error. Minor fusion artifacts at the handle and slight edge warping contribute to a low overall artifact score. Compared to Reference 2 (artifact_score 3.00, which likely had minor issues), this image is worse due to the blatant physical impossibility of the cord, warranting a score closer to Reference 1 (artifact_score 1.00) but slightly higher because the main body is coherent.
